OneDrive.Options.Heading: Locations shown under This PC
OneDrive.Options.Intro: Sync folders already set up on this PC are listed automatically. Rename or hide any of them, or add a folder yourself. Nexaflow only reads folders that are already on this machine — it never signs in to OneDrive.
OneDrive.Options.EmptyHint: OneDrive isn't set up on this PC. You can still add a folder below — anything you point at will appear under This PC.
OneDrive.Options.ShowTip: Show this location under This PC
OneDrive.Options.DetectedTip: Found on this PC — its folder can't be changed here
OneDrive.Options.ChooseFolderTitle: Choose a folder to show under This PC
